news.headline: Delta weight‑and‑balance automation glitch causes nationwide flight delays ahead of Thanksgiving
news.summary: Delta Air Lines experienced a failure in its automated weight‑and‑balance system, prompting the FAA to issue a ground stop at Atlanta's Hartsfield‑Jackson airport and causing delays on hundreds of flights across the United States. The issue was isolated to Delta's internal systems and not related to FAA communications. Travelers heading into the Thanksgiving travel period were affected, and the airline is working to restore the system. The disruptions highlight the vulnerability of airline reliance on automated safety checks.

news.headline: Republican senators accuse Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick of ignoring AI chip export warnings
news.summary: Sen. Tom Cotton and Sen. John Kennedy said they sent multiple letters to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick warning that U.S. AI chips were being smuggled to China. They claim the warnings were ignored, raising national‑security concerns about export controls. The allegations have drawn bipartisan scrutiny and calls for answers from Treasury and the White House. The issue is tied to broader debates over China, technology security, and the Trump administration’s handling of the Commerce Department.

news.headline: Democrats secure 258 House seats, largest majority since 1992
news.summary: In the 2026 midterm elections, Democrats won at least 258 seats in the U.S. House of Representatives, the biggest regular‑election majority in three decades. The result follows key victories such as Chuck Hubbard's narrow win over incumbent Republican Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. The large caucus gives Democrats greater legislative leverage but also raises expectations for delivering on their agenda. The outcome is being reported across the political spectrum.

news.headline: Trump signals openness to working with Democrat Abdul El‑Sayed on Medicare‑for‑All
news.summary: President Trump indicated a willingness to work with Michigan sen‑elect Abdul El‑Sayed on a single‑payer health‑care plan. El‑Sayed said he would support the legislation even if it were branded “TrumpCare.” The discussion took place on NBC’s Meet the Press. The exchange is notable because it could shape bipartisan debate over health‑care reform.

news.headline: Trump says working with Chuck Schumer would be "very hard" if he becomes Senate majority leader
news.summary: President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social that it would be very hard for him to work with Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer if the Democrat becomes majority leader in January. The comment came as Senate Democrats prepare to select their leader after gaining control of the chamber. Trump framed the prospect as a difficulty, while no specific policy issues were cited. The remarks highlight partisan tensions ahead of the new Senate session.

news.headline: ICE arrests two visa overstayers at Seattle airport, sparking political outcry
news.summary: Federal immigration agents detained two passengers on a jet bridge at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. The arrests were captured on video and led to statements from Washington Governor Bob Ferguson and other officials. The incident has intensified scrutiny of ICE ahead of upcoming congressional elections. Both parties are debating the agency's tactics and authority.

news.headline: Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeats Rep. Virginia Foxx in NC's 5th District after recount
news.summary: Incumbent Rep. Virginia Foxx (R-N.C.) conceded defeat to challenger Chuck Hubbard (D) after a recount confirmed Hubbard's 330‑vote lead in North Carolina's 5th Congressional District. The race was closely watched because Foxx chaired the House Rules Committee and the seat was pivotal for the upcoming House majority. The recount changed only one vote, solidifying Hubbard's win. The result contributes to Democrats gaining a sizable majority in the House.

news.headline: Former Broncos linebacker and ESPN analyst Tom Jackson dies at 75
news.summary: Tom Jackson, a former Denver Broncos linebacker who played on the "Orange Crush" defense, died at age 75. He later became a longtime ESPN analyst on shows such as Sunday NFL Countdown. His death was announced by colleague Chris Berman. The news was reported across multiple outlets.

news.headline: Jeffries, Bessent and Microsoft exec discuss cyber outages and bipartisan options on Face the Nation
news.summary: On November 22, 2026, CBS News' Face the Nation featured House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Microsoft President Brad Smith. The guests addressed recent technology outages at major banks and the possibility of Democratic‑Republican cooperation on healthcare policy. The discussion highlighted concerns about cybersecurity, economic stability and the political climate ahead of the upcoming election.

news.headline: DNI Jay Clayton defends Trump's description of Putin as a friend
news.summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told multiple news programs that he trusts President Trump and defended the president's use of the term "friend" for Russian President Vladimir Putin. Clayton distinguished between Trump's personal remarks and official U.S. policy, noting that Putin is not a friend of the United States in the Ukraine conflict. The comments have drawn sharp reactions from both left‑leaning and right‑leaning media outlets. The issue highlights ongoing debate over the administration's stance toward Russia.
